limitations: Author-curated pilot, not independently reviewed. Original summaries reference immutable official documentation snapshots; upstream document text is not redistributed. Exact release scopes are deliberate, not claims about all v1/v2 releases or pydantic.v1 imports.

fields.Description: Export a Pydantic model and its nested models as dictionaries.
fields.Do: Use model.dict() for recursive dictionary export in the v1 API.
fields.Don't: Do not substitute dict(model) when nested models must become dictionaries; that operation retains raw field values.
fields.When to Use: Code imports BaseModel from the installed Pydantic v1 package.
fields.Verification Method: Regression-check nested models and include/exclude options against the application's expected output.
fields.Platform Assumptions: Python; native pydantic v1 API, not the pydantic.v1 compatibility namespace in a v2 installation.

fields.Description: Migrate dictionary serialization from the v1 API to the v2 API.
fields.Do: Use model.model_dump() in v2 where v1 code used model.dict().
fields.Don't: Do not assume serialized output is unchanged across the migration; deprecated APIs and JSON formatting differ.
fields.When to Use: Code imports BaseModel from the native Pydantic v2 API.
fields.Verification Method: Regression-check nested models, aliases, include/exclude options and JSON consumers before switching APIs.
fields.Platform Assumptions: Python; native pydantic v2 API, not pydantic.v1 imports.

fields.Description: Construct a Pydantic v1 model from object attributes.
fields.Do: Set Config.orm_mode = True and construct the model with from_orm().
fields.Don't: Do not call from_orm() without enabling orm_mode.
fields.When to Use: Native Pydantic v1 models consume ORM objects rather than dictionaries.
fields.Verification Method: Test attribute-backed and nested objects with the actual model configuration.

fields.Description: Migrate attribute-backed object validation from v1 from_orm() to v2.
fields.Do: Enable from_attributes=True in model configuration and use model_validate().
fields.Don't: Do not rename from_orm() alone without configuring attribute access; from_orm() is deprecated in v2.
fields.When to Use: Native Pydantic v2 models consume ORM objects rather than dictionaries.
fields.Verification Method: Test attribute-backed and nested objects and review validation errors during migration.
fields.Platform Assumptions: Python; native pydantic v2 API, not pydantic.v1 imports.
